description: Text-only Qwen model profile for local inference. Optimized for synthesis/aggregation tasks over text input — used when the vision encoder of the VL variant is unnecessary overhead.
disclaimer: This data source is not associated with, endorsed by, or approved by Qwen / Alibaba. It loads open-weights Qwen text-only models for local inference. BrainBoost Ltd. is not responsible for any damages, losses, or issues resulting from its use.

sections.title: Qwen Text (local)
sections.text: Loads a text-only Qwen LLM (no vision encoder) for local inference. Half the VRAM of the equivalent VL model. Recommended when the input is text (e.g. JSON synthesis, summarization, episode aggregation).
list: Vision support: none — use SubjectiveQwenLocalDataSource for image inputs
Typical use: episode synthesis from accumulated atom JSONs
